# xterm.js

The Harness tab's terminal (`../../harness.js`). Copied unchanged from the npm packages, less each file's last line (its
`sourceMappingURL` comment, whose map is not shipped):

| File | Package | From |
|---|---|---|
| `xterm.mjs` | `@xterm/xterm@6.0.0` | `lib/xterm.mjs` |
| `xterm.css` | `@xterm/xterm@6.0.0` | `css/xterm.css` |
| `addon-fit.mjs` | `@xterm/addon-fit@0.11.0` | `lib/addon-fit.mjs` |

`LICENSE` is xterm.js's (MIT), which covers both packages.
